description: How long a pot lasts drawing a percentage of it in year one, rising with inflation, at a growth rate. A single path, not a simulation, so it gives no odds. Use for 'how long would £400k last at 4%'.

inflationRatePct.description: Inflation a year, applied to the withdrawal. Defaults to 2.5.

startingPot.description: The pot at retirement, in pounds.

withdrawalRatePct.description: Taken in year one as a share of the pot. Defaults to 4.

name: calculate_retirement_drawdown
title: Retirement drawdown
